decisive_items: small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses
response.rationale: R2 uniquely aligns with the raw IHC and morphology: diffuse CD99 positivity, small round cells, and pseudo-rosettes are classic for Ewing's sarcoma. R5 only supports uterine location/invasion without IHC specificity. R4 is contradicted by CD99 positivity and keratin negativity; R1 is contradicted by CD99 positivity; R6 is contradicted by location and DOG1 negativity.

rejected.why: Raw contradictions include CD99 positivity and keratin negativity, which are inconsistent with DSRCT.
CD99 positivity is listed as both support and contradiction; the IHC profile does not fit solitary fibrous tumor.
Location in uterine fundus/cornua and small round cells contradict GIST; DOG1 negativity is also disconfirming.
